items.headline: Oracle declines as reported force-majeure notice raises concerns about a New Mexico data-center project
items.summary: Oracle shares fell almost 5% during midday trading after reports that the company invoked force majeure on a New Mexico data-center project, increasing investor concerns about potential project delays.

items.headline: Meta gains after debut of VR glasses and handheld device linked to its Muse AI agent
items.summary: Meta Platforms gained after the launch of new VR glasses and a handheld device designed to work with the company’s recently launched Muse AI agent.

items.headline: AI-linked semiconductor shares decline in premarket trading
items.summary: Micron fell 1.69% in premarket trading as most listed AI-related shares declined. SanDisk, Western Digital, Seagate, Marvell, Applied Optoelectronics, Lumentum, Coherent, and Nokia also moved lower.

items.headline: Nokia leads listed AI-related stocks lower in premarket trading
items.summary: Nokia fell 3.95%, the largest decline among the AI-related stocks listed in the report, while other data-storage, networking, optical, and semiconductor names also declined.

items.headline: Generac jumps on multiyear Amazon data-center generator agreement
items.summary: Generac shares rose 18.3% after news of a multiyear agreement to supply backup power generators for Amazon data centers. The report said initial deliveries are expected to total $2.4 billion by 2028.

items.headline: Amazon data-center power agreement reinforces investor focus on AI infrastructure spending
items.summary: A reported multiyear Generac agreement to supply backup generators for Amazon data centers was presented as evidence that data-center infrastructure spending remains intact.

items.headline: Report says Pentagon gave SpaceX access to classified space-tracking data
items.summary: TheStreet reported that the Defense Department had agreed to give SpaceX access to highly classified space-tracking data in exchange for data from the company’s Stargaze cameras. The report said SpaceX shares slipped 0.34% in premarket trading.
